statement: The record indicates that invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291 despite currently showing a status of unpaid and due.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record contradicts itself — "already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291 despite currently showing a status of unpaid and due" — identifying the payment status as the erroneous value.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
